metadata.title: [DEMO DATA] AWS IAM and S3 access controls — sample results

import_ap.remarks: Demo data: no assessment plan exists.

observations.description: [DEMO DATA] [DEMO DATA — synthetic evidence] Design and implementation: at the time of the read, the password policy meets the minimum length (14) and the complexity rules in the test step (symbols, numbers, uppercase). Operating effectiveness over the period was not tested.

[DEMO DATA] [DEMO DATA — no evidence] No available evidence tool covers this control (review sign-offs are held outside AWS), so it was not tested. It is a key control: before Gate 3 the auditor must either extend testing (for example, inspect the review sign-offs) or report it as a scope limitation.

[DEMO DATA] [DEMO DATA — synthetic evidence] All three buckets in the population were tested (full population from ListBuckets). One bucket is public through an ACL granting AllUsers READ, with Block Public Access off at both account and bucket level; for that bucket the control is not implemented as designed.
